term: necessary in sense s (NecessaryIn s m w CN x)
definition: Sense-relative necessary-being predicate over the finite enum Sense, defined by cases: boxK = Holds frame V w (box (atom x)) for the existence valuation V (x exists at every world accessible from w; frame class K; the same as Kant's NecessaryAt, by Iff.rfl); actualistK = x exists at w and boxK; deDictoK = Box frame (fun v => exists y, y exists at v) w (necessarily something exists; necessity of the proposition, not of x); boxT, boxS4, boxB, boxS5 = FrameSatisfies KT / S4 / KTB / S5 of the route's frame and boxK; tertiaVia = IsNecessary of ST I q.2 a.3 with possibility read as the frame's diamond at w; perSe = IsNecessaryPerSe under the same possibility for a supplied relation 'c causes the necessity of x'. Worlds are complete possible histories; none of the senses is eternity or immutability (#469). Strength order: S5 -> S4 -> T -> actualist K -> K -> {de dicto K, tertia via}; S5 -> KTB -> T; per se -> tertia via.
note: Stipulative analyst enumeration (owner direction 2026-11-07), attribution deferred. Each constructor unfolds to an existing declaration of a DISAMB-NECESSARY sense (DEF-KANT-MODAL-NECESSITY, DEF-MODAL-FIXTURE-FRAME, DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY box, DEF-NECESSARY-BEING, DEF-NECESSARY-PER-SE). Left out, and so attackable through STMT-NECESSARY-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE: logical necessity (DEF-LOGICAL-NECESSITY, said of propositions, no Lean declaration) and the essence-based DEF-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE-SCOTT, DEF-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE-GOEDEL-1970 and DEF-FILTERED-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE (the route supplies no essences).
